annotations.title: Purifie your hartes.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Man (vve ſee here) maketh him ſelf cleane and purgeth his owne hart. Which derogateth nothing to the grace of God being the principal cauſe of the ſame. Yet Proteſtants thinke vve derogate from Chriſts Paſſion, when we attribute ſuch effects to our owne workes, or to other ſecundarie helpes and cauſes.

notes.text: Mans working with Gods grace, is no derogation therevnto.
